field_principles.command_receipts: bounded command transcripts with exit codes, summaries, hashes, timing, and blockers.
field_principles.cpu_status: local CPU descriptor-smoke status used as a hash reference.
field_principles.cuda_status: local CUDA smoke status, not a matched speedup benchmark.
field_principles.descriptor_source: names Exp5505 when ready or records the Exp5491 fallback.
field_principles.descriptor_source_ready: prevents board receipts from implying descriptor readiness.
field_principles.gatemate_status: DirtyJTAG detect-only status without flash or workload overclaim.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claim: must remain false without authenticated matched timing.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal status with no speedup overclaim.
field_principles.inference_substrate: hardware_smoke, not live LLM inference or benchmark acceleration.
field_principles.kv260_status: SSH-only KV260 status; never host SD-card storage.
field_principles.matched_hashes: only hash matches over the selected descriptor smoke workload.
field_principles.matched_timing_available: false until authenticated equivalent-work timing exists.
field_principles.polar_fire_status: per-board terminal status from SSH identity and smoke evidence.
